question: Tokyo 2020 Paralympic Games bronze medallist, Manoj Sarkar, is associated with which of the following events?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Badminton.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Manoj Sarkar **is a** para-badminton player** from India.
 
• He has collected **50 international medals,** including** 19 gold, 13 silver, and 18 bron**ze.
 
• He is a** Uttarakhand native.**
 
• In **2018**, the President of India presented him with the **Arjun award.**
 
• Through its** Para Champions Program,** the **GoSports Foundation** supports him.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The** international multi-sport Tokyo 2020 Paralympic Games** were held in **Tokyo, Japan,** from **24 August to 5 September 2021.**
 
• The** International Paralympic Committee** staged them as the **16th Summer Paralympic Games**.
 
• With** 207** total medals, **China **took first place.
 
• **Great Britain** came in **second with 124 medals** overall.
 
• With** 104 total medals**, the** United States **came in third place.
 
• India took home** five gold medals, eight silver medals, and six bronze **medals (total **19). **
